# Law360 Pulse writes that more GCs are "turning litigation into a strategic profit tool"


November 25, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Law360 Pulse* writes that more GCs are "turning litigation into a strategic profit tool."


Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) notes, "What I think is clear is that corporations increasingly realize that, in an economic environment like the one we're in, leaving meritorious claims on the table is no longer a desirable option."


Read more[here](https://www.law360.com/pulse/articles/2412867) .
